description: Robots just ran a half marathon in Beijing. They weren't just moving. They were competing, stumbling, and pushing through like real racers. So is this a fun spectacle, or a serious glimpse into where technology is taking us? And when humans and machines share the same track... who are we really cheering for? On the show: Steve, Fei Fei & Yushun
classificationReason: Entire episode examines humanoid robots competing in a Beijing half marathon and the implications for robotics.
qualityReason: Focused reporting and discussion, but the description suggests a relatively short news-style segment.
